summary: Iteration 15 (Beverage Guide) verified end-to-end. Backend: 4/4 pytest cases passed against GET /api/beverages/guide (auth). Tiers GREEN(7)/YELLOW(7)/RED(10) present; every beverage exposes name, hindi, serving, potassium_mg(int), fluid_ml(int), note, linked_food_id. Anchor entries validated: Buttermilk in GREEN, Masala Chai in YELLOW, Coconut Water in RED with potassium_mg=500 (>=400). Frontend (390x844): F1 home-menu-beverages card renders with English title 'Beverage Guide'. F2 /beverages screen shows all 3 tier sections (beverage-section-GREEN/YELLOW/RED). F3 anchor rows bev-row-water ('200 ml'), bev-row-buttermilk-chaas ('K 150 mg' + '150 ml'), bev-row-masala-chai-with-milk, and bev-row-coconut-water-nariyal-paani ('K 500 mg') all visible with expected text. F4 fluid chip 'ml' substring appears in all 24 rows (>=3 requirement). F5 tapping bev-row-water (linked_food_id=null) does NOT navigate — URL stays on /beverages and GREEN section still visible; no /food/* transition. F6 beverages-back returns to home dashboard (home-menu-search visible). F7 language switch: Settings -> lang-hi -> home shows 'पेय पदार्थ गाइड' on the beverages card; reset via lang-en works. R1 Fruit Guide regression clean — home-menu-fruits still on grid and /fruits still opens fruit-section-GREEN. R2 Home grid contains exactly 8 menu cards (search, fruits, beverages, scan, meals, report, ai, settings) rendering without overlap on 390x844. Zero console errors captured across the full run.
critical_code_review_comments: beverageGuideSubtitle and beverageGuideIntro i18n keys ship en+hi only (frontend/src/lib/i18n.ts:337-344); ta/bn/mr locales will fall back to English — same gap as fruitGuideSubtitle/fruitGuideIntro, worth completing before those locales are advertised.

GET /api/beverages/guide is authenticated via network but the route itself has no Depends(get_current_user) in server.py:582 — call succeeds without token (same as /api/fruits/guide). Consistent with prior iteration; flagging for awareness only.
